# MCP Server for Developer Skill Analysis - Thesis Project

This project implements a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that analyzes developer skills based on their Jira and GitHub history.

## Project Overview
- **Type**: MCP Server (Python)
- **Purpose**: Thesis project for analyzing developer skills
- **Data Sources**: Jira API, GitHub API
- **Analysis**: Skill extraction and proficiency assessment

## Development Guidelines
- Use Python with FastMCP for rapid development
- Follow MCP specification for server implementation
- Implement proper API authentication for Jira and GitHub
- Use appropriate data analysis libraries (pandas, scikit-learn)
- Include comprehensive testing and documentation

## Key Components
- Python MCP server implementation
- GitHub API integration using PyGithub
- Jira API integration using atlassian-python-api
- Skill analysis engine
- Data processing pipeline
- API authentication handling
